calibration_sources: NVIDIA GPU XID Errors Documentation & HBM3/HBM3e Dynamic Row-Remapper Failure Policies (XID 31, 43, 48, 63, 64, 74, 79, 94, 95)
DMTF Redfish Telemetry Service (SSE) & NVIDIA HGX Baseboard Management Controller (BMC over MCTP/SMBPBI) Architecture
Large-Scale AI Cluster Hardware RAS & Automated Node Remediation Workflows

workload.cluster_scale: 2,048-GPU H100/H200 HGX Cluster (256 Nodes × 8 GPUs, >700 sensors/node across GPUs, 4 NVSwitches, PCIe Retimers, and VRMs)
workload.xid_taxonomy: User-App Faults: XID 13/31 (MMU Page Fault), XID 43 (App Stopped) -> Do NOT Cordon; Transient/Resettable HW: XID 74 (NVLink), XID 94 (Contained ECC), XID 63 (Row Remap Pending) -> Warm Reset/Reboot; Hard Bus Lock: XID 79 (Fallen Off Bus) -> OOB Cold AC Power Cycle; Terminal HW: XID 64 (Row Remap Failure), XID 48/95 -> Cordon & RMA
workload.inband_vs_oob_gap: When XID 79 or PCIe root lockup occurs, Linux kernel freezes and in-band kubelet/dcgm-exporter stops responding; only Out-of-Band BMC Redfish over SMBPBI can read GPU status and trigger AC cycle

tiers.name: Tier 1: 被动人工查 dmesg + 传统 IPMI 轮询 (分不清代码报错与硬件坏卡 · MTTR 285 分钟 ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Reactive dmesg Hunting + Legacy IPMI Polling (285.0 min MTTR, Blind to HGX GPU Sensors)
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy CPU servers only; IPMI lacks bandwidth for 700+ HGX baseboard sensors and leaves hung GPU nodes unrecovered for hours.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 带内 DCGM Exporter + 一刀切 NPD 隔离 (遇 XID 31 用户越界也封锁整台 8 卡机 = 68% 误杀 ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: In-Band DCGM Exporter + Blanket Node Problem Detector (68% False Cordons on User XID 31, Blind to OS Hang)
tiers.recommended_for: Basic K8s metric collection; suffers from massive false-positive node drains when user Triton/CUDA kernels trigger XID 31/43.

tiers.name: Tier 3: XID 三级分类状态机 + HBM 动态行重映射门禁 (精准区分代码 Bug XID 31 与硬件故障 XID 63/64/79)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: XID 3-Tier Severity Classifier + HBM Row-Remapper Gate (Distinguishes User XID 31 from HW XID 63/64/79)
tiers.recommended_for: Standard cloud GPU nodes where host OS access is managed by the cloud provider.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 带外 Redfish SSE 流式遥测 (SMBPBI) + 四阶自动自愈闭环 (热重置 → 带外冷断电重启 → 自动报修 RMA 🏆)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Out-of-Band Redfish SSE Telemetry (SMBPBI) + 4-Stage Auto-Remediation (Warm Reset -> Cold AC Cycle -> Auto-RMA)
tiers.recommended_for: Bare-metal 512–32,768 GPU AI factories: detects XID 79 bus hangs out-of-band in 3.5s and cuts MTTR by 118.8x (285 -> 2.4 min).
